mapper.insert: insert into att_employee_face(employee_id,encrypted_feature,model,version,updated_by,updated_time) values(#{employeeId},#{encryptedFeature},#{model},1,#{updatedBy},now()) on duplicate key update encrypted_feature=values(encrypted_feature),model=values(model),version=version+1,updated_by=values(updated_by),updated_time=now()
mapper.select: select record_id as recordId,score,threshold,profile_version as profileVersion,model, date_format(verified_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as verifiedTime from att_face_verification where record_id=#{recordId}
